finding_resolution.analysis: The pre-commit snapshot now records whether the unchanged focused descendant intersected the old Reader viewport. The post-commit adjustment is bounded by max(0, current focus top minus new pane top), capped at the original pane displacement. For the original counterexample, focus top599 and pane top493 allow106px rather than399px, leaving the control at493..533 inside493..818. Focus identity and node/viewport/scroll restoration checks still run before this calculation. When the same focused control already lies in the remaining viewport, its available distance permits the full required compensation. No focus movement or direct state/CAS operation is introduced.
